text: The rollout reports success a few minutes after Theo applies the fix — but a clean rollout is a checkpoint, not proof the incident is actually over.
Theo re-checks the same per-zone pod listing from Lesson 12. Now there are exactly four checkout-api pods in each of the three zones, matching what the spread constraint was designed to guarantee.
Per-zone CPU utilization now sits close together across all three zones, roughly forty-six to forty-eight percent — no zone saturated, none idle.

The real proof is the reliability dashboard returning to baseline — p95 latency back near one hundred ninety milliseconds, error rate back near point two percent — while the sale's real traffic keeps climbing. Next lesson: writing it all down.
